intended_use: Synthetic pipeline demonstration; unvalidated on gameplay
threshold_selection: maximum validation balanced accuracy; ties nearest 0.5

training.augmentation: train only: bilinear translation +/-2.88 px, gain 0.8-1.2, Gaussian noise sigma 0.012

generator.group_seed_rule: seed + group_index * 104729; separate numpy generator per group
generator.limitation: Artificial text/noise only. No game frames, capture artifacts or evidence of gameplay accuracy.
